Tenant.definition: Administrative data-isolation boundary, independent of legal entities and brands.

Record.definition: Identifiable tenant-owned domain record with explicit provenance and version metadata.

ExternalIdentifier.definition: Identifier qualified by scheme, assigning authority and validity; equality does not imply entity equivalence.

EvidenceDocument.definition: Retained evidence described by content digest and storage reference, without embedding credentials.

TimeWindow.definition: Half-open UTC interval with an inclusive start and exclusive end.

RecurringWindow.definition: Local recurring opening or pricing window with explicit timezone and overnight semantics.

Address.definition: Structured postal address; optional fields accommodate national differences.

GeoPosition.definition: Geodetic position in WGS84 decimal degrees.

Currency.definition: Tenant-enabled monetary currency with ISO code and minor-unit precision.

ExchangeRate.definition: Directional currency conversion quote tied to an instant and provider.

Quantity.definition: Numerical quantity with explicit unit and physical dimension.

Annotation.definition: Authored note attached to a domain record; stored independently from controlled classifications.

CustomFieldDefinition.definition: Versioned, named extension field with declared datatype and applicable class IRI.

CustomFieldValue.definition: Typed extension value associated with its definition, not a substitute for modeled core properties.

LegalEntity.definition: Legal person participating in charging services; role is represented separately.

Person.definition: Minimal person reference; personally identifying details remain purpose-controlled.

ContactProfile.definition: Purpose-specific contact details with visibility and retention boundaries.

PartyRole.definition: Time-qualified business role held by a legal entity within a service context.

OperatorService.definition: Business service operating a network or driver offering within one tenant.

Principal.definition: Human or machine security subject linked to an identity provider by opaque reference.

Permission.definition: Named action permission for a class or bounded resource scope.

SecurityRole.definition: Named collection of permissions; not an organization business role.

AccessGrant.definition: Time-qualified grant of permissions to a principal over an explicit scope.

ManagementDelegation.definition: Authorized delegation of operational responsibility, without changing asset ownership.

CustomerAccount.definition: Service account used for charging and commercial relationships; may represent an ad hoc customer.

CustomerGroup.definition: Group for pricing, eligibility, reporting or access; membership is explicit and temporal.

GroupMembership.definition: Time-bound association of a customer account with a group.

UserDevice.definition: Client-device registration using an opaque push or device reference.

ChargingSite.definition: Physical place containing charging infrastructure, separated from its public listing.

ChargingArea.definition: Named subdivision of a physical charging site.

ParkingSpace.definition: Physical parking bay that can serve one or more reachable charging units.

PublicListing.definition: Published representation of a site for discovery or roaming, with audience and publication state.

SiteAccessPolicy.definition: Rules for physical or service access, independent of map visibility.

ServiceNotice.definition: Localized customer information with severity and effective interval.

MediaAsset.definition: Image or media associated with a place or brand, with rights and language metadata.

SharingAgreement.definition: Time-limited sharing of an asset with an account or partner, preserving ownership.

SharingInvitation.definition: Invitation to accept asset access; stores a secret reference rather than an invitation token.

Manufacturer.definition: Organization manufacturing charging equipment; identified separately from models.

EquipmentModel.definition: Versioned hardware model and its declared electrical and communication capabilities.

DeviceCapability.definition: Capability assertion with source, firmware context and verification status.

ChargingStation.definition: Managed physical assembly that may host multiple charging units or use a gateway.

ChargingUnit.definition: Logical EVSE capable of supplying one vehicle at a time; may expose multiple alternative connectors.

Connector.definition: Physical vehicle interface attached to a charging unit.

ElectricityMeter.definition: Meter measuring site or charging energy; sensor role is separate from commercial evidence.

CalibrationRecord.definition: Metrology certification and validity information, without assuming compliance from a label.

ElectricalCircuit.definition: Physical circuit topology and conductor ratings; distinct from virtual allocation groups.

ElectricalConnection.definition: Physical attachment of charging equipment to a circuit and mapped conductors.

OwnershipTransfer.definition: Effective-time transfer of asset ownership retaining previous accountability.

ProtocolEndpoint.definition: Versioned charger communication endpoint with identity and credential reference.

ConfigurationVariable.definition: Desired and observed device configuration, including component and EVSE addressing.

ConfigurationTemplate.definition: Reusable versioned collection of desired device configuration values.

ConfigurationTemplateEntry.definition: One typed variable assignment within a configuration template.

TemplateApplication.definition: Auditable attempt to apply a configuration template to a station.

FirmwareRelease.definition: Firmware artifact with immutable digest, compatibility and verification information.

FirmwareDeployment.definition: Scheduled rollout to a station with explicit progression and rollback reference.

HardwareStatusObservation.definition: Timestamped equipment state from a specific reporting source.

ConnectionObservation.definition: Network reachability observation separated from physical availability and administrative state.

DiagnosticArtifact.definition: Diagnostic or security log collection associated with a request and result.

Vehicle.definition: Vehicle reference with technical data and controlled identity information.

VehicleAssignment.definition: Time-qualified access of a customer account to a vehicle.

VehicleTelemetry.definition: Timestamped vehicle values with provenance and units fixed by property names.

ChargingCredential.definition: Opaque charging credential; RFID, Autocharge and certificate identities remain distinguishable.

CredentialAssignment.definition: Time-bound assignment of a charging credential to a customer or vehicle.

AuthorizationRequest.definition: Request to authorize charging including context, source and requested target.

AuthorizationDecision.definition: Explicit charging decision with reason, policy and offline or remote origin.

LocalAuthorizationList.definition: Versioned local cache distributed to a charger, separate from online authorization.

LocalAuthorizationEntry.definition: Credential entry in a local authorization snapshot.

PlugAndChargeEnrollment.definition: Enrollment joining a customer, vehicle provisioning identity and charging contract certificate.

ProvisioningCertificate.definition: Vehicle provisioning-certificate identifier and lifecycle, without private key material.

RemoteCommand.definition: Persisted asynchronous action request; acknowledgement and achieved outcome are separate.

CommandParameter.definition: Typed parameter of a domain command with a declared semantic key.

CommandOutcome.definition: Reported acknowledgement or terminal outcome of one command.

BookingRequest.definition: Request to allocate charging or parking over a future interval, including modification/cancellation intent.

Booking.definition: Confirmed future allocation tied to a request, distinct from immediate charger reservation.

Reservation.definition: Immediate resource hold with an expiry and optional booking linkage.

SourceEvent.definition: Immutable source envelope identifying event time, receipt time, producer and retained payload.

ChargingSession.definition: Canonical charging lifecycle independent of wire transactions and financial settlement.

ProtocolTransaction.definition: Wire-protocol transaction scoped to endpoint and boot epoch; may be one fragment of a session.

SessionEvent.definition: Ordered lifecycle evidence for a canonical session, with a source envelope.

ChargingInterval.definition: Segment of a session with phase of activity and interval usage.

MeterObservation.definition: One measured value preserving measurand, unit, phase, direction and measurement quality.

SignedMeterEvidence.definition: Cryptographically signed metering evidence with signing identity and verification result.

SessionEndEvidence.definition: Basis and quality of session finalization, allowing physical or administrative closure to be distinguished.

UsageAggregate.definition: Reproducible time-bucketed usage with direction and aggregation policy.

ChargeDetailRecord.definition: Immutable commercial usage record; can represent local or external charging and correction lineage.

Tariff.definition: Stable identity of a commercial pricing offer whose versions hold the immutable terms.

TariffVersion.definition: Immutable price definition including effective window, currency and component rules.

PriceComponent.definition: Charge dimension with explicit unit price, billing increment and thresholds.

PricingCondition.definition: Typed eligibility predicate for a pricing rule, using an explicit comparator and typed value.

TariffSet.definition: Ordered candidate selection policy, with explicit default and offline pricing.

TariffAssignment.definition: Membership of a tariff version in a selection set, with explicit priority.

TariffResolution.definition: Recorded result of price selection, including input evidence and resolver version.

ScheduledTariffChange.definition: Future activation of a tariff version with accountable scheduling and outcome.

DynamicPriceFormula.definition: Versioned formula referencing price feeds, markup and fallback; executable implementation is external.

ElectricityPriceSchedule.definition: Energy procurement price source, distinct from customer charging tariffs.

ElectricityPriceInterval.definition: Price for an explicit interval or recurring local window; one timing form is required.

EnergyMix.definition: Attributed electricity generation mix with period and evidential origin.

EnergySourceShare.definition: Fraction of generation from one energy source.

PriceDisplay.definition: Localized pre-session price disclosure and the tariff version it describes.

RoundingPolicy.definition: Explicit rounding mode and granularity for reproducible commercial calculations.

SessionLimitPolicy.definition: Limits on charging start or continuation with an explicit enforcement outcome.

BillingProfile.definition: Versionable invoice-party details captured when financial documents are issued.

TaxIdentifier.definition: Tax registration identifier qualified by issuing jurisdiction and identifier type.

TaxRule.definition: Versioned tax rule selected by jurisdiction and supply context; not a global VAT default.

TaxDetermination.definition: Recorded tax treatment and evidential facts for a supply or billing line.

RatingCalculation.definition: Versioned calculation of a session charge from immutable tariff and usage inputs.

RatedLine.definition: Priced usage or fee component with quantity, rounding and tax evidence.

Invoice.definition: Issued or draft accounting document with independent lifecycle and issuer numbering.

InvoiceLine.definition: Invoice line linked to rated or contractual supply evidence.

CreditNote.definition: Accounting correction linked to an original invoice, separate from refund execution.

Receipt.definition: Evidence of a monetary receipt tied to payment capture and optional invoice.

DocumentNumberSequence.definition: Issuer-scoped numbering configuration with preserved string prefixes and auditability.

FiscalizationAttempt.definition: Attempt to submit an invoice to a fiscal authority, with retry and authority outcome.

CustomFee.definition: Explicit non-session fee tied to a customer and accounting basis.

PaymentInstrument.definition: PSP or account reference for payment; never a primary card number or secret.

PaymentIntent.definition: Commercial obligation to collect money with provider-independent lifecycle.

PaymentAuthorization.definition: PSP authorization or preauthorization; does not prove capture.

PaymentCapture.definition: Confirmed or pending capture against a payment intent.

Refund.definition: Payment reversal request and result linked to one original capture.

Chargeback.definition: Dispute raised through a payment provider with evidential deadline and outcome.

Wallet.definition: Customer monetary balance projection, backed by immutable ledger entries.

WalletEntry.definition: Signed customer balance movement linked to immutable journal evidence.

LedgerAccount.definition: Currency-specific accounting account within a tenant ledger.

Journal.definition: Balanced accounting posting group; posted entries are immutable.

JournalLine.definition: Signed debit-positive accounting amount in one currency account.

TopUpOffer.definition: Purchase offer for funding a wallet, separating purchase price and credited value.

Voucher.definition: Monetary redemption instrument with opaque code reference and finite redemption terms.

VoucherRedemption.definition: Recorded application of voucher value to a customer's wallet.

PaymentTerminal.definition: Payment device serving exactly one station or charging area.

SubscriptionPlan.definition: Versioned recurring commercial plan with charging benefits and billing policy.

Subscription.definition: Customer enrollment in a plan with explicit renewal and cancellation semantics.

BillingPeriod.definition: Accountable period for subscription accrual, invoicing and allowance reset.

BenefitAllowance.definition: Plan benefit measured in an explicit dimension with reset semantics.

AllowanceConsumption.definition: Consumption of a plan allowance with session and period evidence.

EnergyCouponTemplate.definition: Issuance and redemption policy for energy-denominated coupons.

EnergyCoupon.definition: Energy entitlement distinct from monetary vouchers and wallet balances.

CouponConsumption.definition: Energy charged against an energy coupon within a session.

ServiceAgreement.definition: Versioned contract defining supplier, counterparty, assets, responsibilities and charging economics.

RevenueShareRule.definition: Contractual allocation of a defined revenue base to a beneficiary.

CostAllocationRule.definition: Contract cost responsibility for a category and beneficiary.

SettlementOverride.definition: Time-scoped exception to a contract settlement rule with authorization evidence.

SettlementBatch.definition: Partner receivable/payable reconciliation over a defined period and currency.

SettlementItem.definition: Individual charge or adjustment attributed under a contract.

ReconciliationCase.definition: Mismatch between expected and observed usage or money with resolution evidence.

PartnerInvitation.definition: Invitation connecting a customer to a partner account and applicable access/billing policies.

CorporateBillingPolicy.definition: Versioned rules deciding which costs a corporate sponsor covers.

CorporateChargerRule.definition: AC/DC-specific sponsor coverage overriding general cost coverage terms.

CorporateBillingSnapshot.definition: Immutable corporate policy selection captured for a charging session.

CorporateCostAllocation.definition: Split of an eligible session charge between sponsor and driver.

ReimbursementPolicy.definition: Date-based home-charge reimbursement rate selection policy.

ReimbursementRecord.definition: Home-charging reimbursement calculation with immutable rate evidence.

ReimbursementReport.definition: Period aggregation of reimbursement records for one payer and currency.

RoamingNetwork.definition: Hub or direct-exchange network with provider identity and supported protocols.

RoamingParty.definition: Counterparty representation with externally scoped CPO or eMSP identity.

RoamingConnection.definition: Contracted technical relationship with negotiated protocol modules and credential references.

RoamingModuleAgreement.definition: Versioned sender/receiver role for one negotiated roaming module.

RoamingExchange.definition: Delivery and acknowledgement of one versioned roaming resource or command.

RoamingCommand.definition: Cross-network command tied to a local command and asynchronous remote outcome.

SynchronizationCursor.definition: Checkpoint of a partner stream retaining negotiated ordering and freshness semantics.

RoamingTariffMapping.definition: Connection-specific imported tariff and local commercial interpretation.

RoamingTariffFilter.definition: Ordered rule for selecting or transforming a remote operator tariff.

PublicDataPublication.definition: Versioned public-data export with schema, audience, freshness and evidence.

GridConnection.definition: Site boundary with contractual import and export power limits.

LoadControlGroup.definition: Virtual allocation group for dynamic load management, separate from physical circuit topology.

ControlGroupMembership.definition: Assignment of a station or unit to a load control group with conductor mapping.

PowerConstraint.definition: Time-limited directional power limit with origin and precedence.

PhaseCurrentConstraint.definition: Per-phase electrical current bound used alongside aggregate power constraints.

PriorityRule.definition: Allocation preference for a customer, asset, session or state-of-charge band.

SmartChargingPreference.definition: Customer charging objective including deadline, target energy and randomized-delay preference.

ChargingSchedule.definition: Time-based power/current proposal with explicit version, purpose and validity.

SchedulePeriod.definition: Non-overlapping interval within a charging schedule with a signed directional setpoint.

ScheduleApplication.definition: Evidence of device acceptance and observed enforcement of a schedule.

UnmanagedLoadObservation.definition: Measured or estimated non-controlled load used for site allocation.

EnergyForecast.definition: Versioned forecast series with issue time, horizon, source and uncertainty semantics.

ForecastPoint.definition: Forecast value and optional interval bounds for one time bucket.

DemandResponseProgram.definition: Utility or aggregator program defining controllable services and measurement obligations.

FlexibilityAsset.definition: Registered control group participating in a flexibility program.

FlexibilityActivation.definition: Requested power adjustment over a defined interval with acceptance and delivery tracking.

FlexibilityDelivery.definition: Measured delivery against an activation and baseline, retaining verification evidence.

DistributedEnergyAsset.definition: Site generation or storage participating in energy management.

VendorFaultDefinition.definition: Vendor-scoped fault meaning, severity and recommended customer or operator response.

Issue.definition: Operational problem with affected assets, chronology, severity and resolution evidence.

RecoveryPolicy.definition: Bounded automated recovery procedure with eligibility, attempts and escalation.

RecoveryAttempt.definition: Audited recovery action linked to an issue and policy.

WorkOrder.definition: Accountable maintenance assignment with scope, provider and completion evidence.

InstallationJob.definition: Commissioning task with installer organization, location, equipment and acceptance result.

OperationalPeriod.definition: Interval included in a precisely defined operational availability denominator.

DowntimePeriod.definition: Planned or unplanned unavailability with cause and notice; exclusions are policy-specific.

AvailabilityPolicy.definition: Versioned definition of downtime inclusion, exclusions and freshness.

AvailabilityResult.definition: Calculated uptime evidence using a stated denominator and policy.

CertificateRecord.definition: Certificate identity, validity and trust metadata with key material held externally.

CertificateLifecycleEvent.definition: Issuance, installation, renewal or revocation evidence for a certificate.

SecurityEvent.definition: Detected security-relevant event with source evidence and triage status.

AuditEntry.definition: Append-only actor-action-result evidence for privileged or business-significant changes.

PolicyDocument.definition: Versioned legal or operational policy with purpose and effective interval.

ConsentDecision.definition: Recorded grant or withdrawal for a specific person, purpose and document version.

RetentionPolicy.definition: Purpose- and jurisdiction-specific retention rule with legal-hold handling.

DataDisposition.definition: Evidence of a requested or completed deletion/anonymization action.

ComplianceAssessment.definition: Provision-specific applicability and evidence assessment; no automatic legal conclusion.

IntegrationConnection.definition: Configured external-service integration with a versioned contract and secret reference.

ApiClient.definition: Machine API identity with bounded permissions and rate-limit policy.

EventSubscription.definition: Subscription to domain event types over a declared transport and filtering scope.

EventDelivery.definition: Idempotent delivery attempt of one source event to one subscription.

CommunicationLog.definition: Bounded request/response metadata and evidence for external communication.

PlatformSetting.definition: Typed, scoped platform configuration, independently versioned from domain state.

BrandProfile.definition: White-label identity and locale configuration shared across customer channels.

ExperienceChannel.definition: Branded driver or partner interface and its audience/capability configuration.

ContentTemplate.definition: Localized versioned communication template with declared placeholders.

HelpArticle.definition: Localized customer-help content with ordering and publication lifecycle.

CustomerNotification.definition: Customer-facing message request and delivery evidence.

ApplicationInstallation.definition: Marketplace or custom extension installed with declared permissions and version.

MetricDefinition.definition: Versioned operational or financial metric with explicit population, denominator and unit.

MetricObservation.definition: Calculated metric value tied to a scope, time interval and definition version.

AssistantRecommendation.definition: AI-assisted operational suggestion with evidence and a separate action approval trail.

ActionApproval.definition: Human approval or rejection of an assistant-proposed operation; never implied by a suggestion.

StateTransition.definition: Recorded transition between controlled states with policy and source evidence.

DiscountRule.definition: Explicit reduction applied to selected price dimensions or a session total; computation order is part of the policy.

FeeBounds.definition: Currency-denominated cap and minimum with an optional quantity cap for one price component.

PriceTier.definition: Tier in a component's piecewise price schedule with explicit accumulation semantics.

PriceFreezePolicy.definition: Defines when a component's selected unit price is frozen, independently of quantities and tax.

SessionPricingPolicy.definition: Session-wide floor, ceiling, fee eligibility and ordered component evaluation policy.

PreauthorizationPolicy.definition: Payment hold policy separated from the tariff's actual charge calculation.

SubsidyRule.definition: Externally funded reduction with a beneficiary, policy version and optional integration authority.

FinancialAccountReference.definition: Payment-provider or vault reference to bank details with masked display values; raw credentials are not required in the graph.

PaymentRouting.definition: Deterministic choice of payment service and merchant account for a transaction.

Payout.definition: Disbursement to a beneficiary account, distinct from collection of a driver's payment.

PayoutBatch.definition: Currency-specific group of disbursements for a funding entity and execution date.

PowerCabinet.definition: Shared DC conversion capacity serving multiple charging units, separate from a station identity.

PowerModuleAllocation.definition: Time-bounded assignment of cabinet power modules to a charging unit.

ChargingProfile.definition: Protocol-independent charging profile preserving purpose, kind, stack precedence and schedule.

RoamingBehaviorPolicy.definition: Versioned interpretation rules at a roaming boundary, including unknown status and tariff precedence.

AccessTokenLease.definition: Metadata for an issued API access token; token material is stored in a secret manager and is never the RDF identifier.

SubscriptionBillingPolicy.definition: Subscription fee accumulation, renewal and personal-charger multipliers independent of the service allowance.

ReimbursementTaxCalculation.definition: Explicit tax interpretation and rounded monetary breakdown of a reimbursement.

ClockAssessment.definition: Recorded clock offset applied to a source timestamp, including method and evidence; preserves the unmodified source time.

ContractObligation.definition: Enforceable duty linking the responsible debtor, beneficiary, contract scope and versioned acceptance policy; financial liability belongs to an identified party.

ObligationAssessment.definition: Dated assessment of a specific contractual duty, preserving decision evidence and authority instead of silently marking it fulfilled.

AgreementLifecycleEvent.definition: Versioned offer, acceptance, amendment, suspension, renewal or termination decision retaining predecessor and successor contract versions.

SettlementApproval.definition: Explicit release decision for partner settlement, including reconciliation, approver, payee and liability for unresolved differences.

ReimbursementApproval.definition: Approval of an employee home-energy claim with measured usage, eligibility, applied rate and prevention of duplicate payment.

ServiceEntitlement.definition: Time-bounded right to consume an explicitly scoped service under a contract, independent of login permissions.

AccountClosure.definition: Account offboarding decision that preserves or explicitly transfers remaining debt, refunds and statutory retention duties.

AssetLifecycleEvent.definition: Evidence-backed commissioning, suspension, relocation, replacement or retirement of a physical asset with explicit operational responsibility.

OperationalAcceptance.definition: Operational handover of an installed charger, including safety, protocol capability, meter readiness and maintenance ownership.

ConnectorCompatibility.definition: Explicit physical and electrical compatibility evaluation before offering a connector to a vehicle.

CommercialOffer.definition: Immutable price disclosure offered before charging, retaining the seller, channel, tax display and applicable tariff version without requiring a registered identity.

OfferAcceptance.definition: Evidence that the customer accepted a disclosed offer before its validity expired; binds the accepted price to one charging journey.

CommercialResponsibility.definition: Commercial chain for a specific service: supplier, merchant of record, tax-liable party, payer, collector and beneficiary are separate legal responsibilities.

OfflineAuthorizationAssessment.definition: Evidence-based decision to admit charging while disconnected, with credential freshness, delegated authority, exposure and reconciliation policy.

EventProcessingOutcome.definition: Exactly-once business-effect evidence for a possibly duplicated or out-of-order source event; storage and atomicity remain runtime obligations.

MeterRegisterEpoch.definition: Identity and calibration context of a cumulative meter register between resets or replacement; readings from different epochs are not subtracted.

MeterDelta.definition: Reconciled usage derived from two readings in the same cumulative register epoch, or explicitly flagged estimation with supporting evidence.

BillingReadinessAssessment.definition: Explicit billability decision preserving final usage, authorization, price, tax, commercial owner and unresolved-exception evidence.

RecordCorrection.definition: Immutable correction case linking original and replacement or credit records, reason, authority and downstream notifications.

FinancialPosition.definition: Currency-specific receivable or payable preserving original amount, credits, collections, write-offs and remaining liability.

PaymentAllocation.definition: Allocation of a confirmed collection to an identified receivable, with matching currency and no duplicated financial effect.

ReconciliationResolution.definition: Resolution of a missing, duplicate or mismatched record, preserving matching identifiers, disposition, corrective evidence and residual liability owner.

ServiceDispute.definition: Customer or partner complaint distinct from a card-network chargeback; captures disputed service, accountable resolver, deadline and remedy.

DunningAction.definition: Versioned decision to remind, suspend collection or write off overdue debt while respecting an active dispute.

BenefitReservation.definition: Reserved allowance that separates concurrency exposure from settled consumption and supports explicit release or consumption.

ControlDecision.definition: Requested versus feasible power decision constrained by physical, contractual and safety limits, with an explicit rejected or accepted outcome.

OverrideAuthorization.definition: Time-limited permission to override an optimization preference; it never grants permission to exceed physical safety limits.

ExportAgreement.definition: Explicit permission, metering and settlement responsibility for bidirectional export rather than assuming import authorization permits export.

DataSubjectRequest.definition: Verified data-subject request with separately recorded eligibility, due date, response and justified refusal or retention decisions.

LegalHold.definition: Scoped evidence-preservation obligation with review date, authority and legal basis; does not justify indefinite retention of all account data.

ProcessingPurpose.definition: Purpose-bound data-processing contract recording controller, processor, categories, lawful basis, retention and cross-border safeguards.

AccessDecision.definition: Time-specific authorization decision for a principal, permission and record scope; an account identity alone grants no operational authority.

EvidenceVerification.definition: Result of retrieving and verifying an evidence artifact, distinguishing claimed evidence from successful digest/signature verification.

ServiceLevelCommitment.definition: Measured service obligation with a contract scope, measurement window, exclusions policy and responsible remediation party.

ServiceLevelBreach.definition: Observed contractual service breach linking measured availability, customer-impact evidence, remediation and commercial liability.

RecoveryExercise.definition: Verified restoration rehearsal with explicit recovery objectives, achieved recovery and evidence rather than an untested backup assertion.

ProtocolProfile.definition: Versioned adapter capability contract with negotiated feature blocks, roles, certification evidence and declared loss/error behavior.

MigrationBatch.definition: Provider migration or tenant exit with source/target identities, counts, reconciliation and credential revocation evidence.

LifecycleSnapshot.definition: Current or historical state assertion with effective time and the specific transition evidence supporting it.

ProcessExecution.definition: End-to-end business journey instance tying domain records, step responsibilities, contractual obligations and financial ownership together.

ProcessStep.definition: Ordered business step retaining responsible actor, concrete input/output records, obligation, failures and compensation evidence.

AllowanceBalance.definition: Per-customer, per-period allowance accounting with explicit opening rollover, grant, consumed usage, active reservations, expiry and remaining value.

TemporalCommit.definition: Immutable recorded-time revision of a complete effective-time map for one tenant and coherent validation scope. System end is derived from its successor commit.

TemporalSlice.definition: Half-open business-time slice selecting one immutable RDF payload graph or an explicit retraction. It belongs to a commit and cannot overlap its sibling slices.

ProjectionWatermark.definition: Source-partition checkpoint defining completeness and lateness for a reproducible semantic projection; offsets are monotonic within a source partition.

TemporalSnapshotSelection.definition: Evidence of a valid-time and known-time selection inside one committed scope; queries use only its selected graph and the recorded schema version.

TemporalStreamPolicy.definition: Explicit policy for event-time disorder and corrections. Beyond-retention evidence is quarantined, and historical payloads are preserved by the reference writer.

rules.message: Tenant-owned object references must remain within the same tenant.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:tenant ?t; ?p ?other. ?p cd:sameTenant true. ?other cd:tenant ?u. FILTER(?t != ?u) }

rules.message: Canonical IDs are unique across all records within a tenant.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:tenant ?t; cd:canonicalId ?id. ?other cd:tenant ?t; cd:canonicalId ?id. FILTER(?other != $this) }

rules.message: Record cannot instantiate explicitly disjoint domain classes.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this a ?a, ?b. ?set owl:members ?members; a owl:AllDisjointClasses. ?members rdf:rest*/rdf:first ?a, ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Unknown predicates in the controlled namespace are rejected.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this ?p ?v. FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?p),"https://example.org/charge-domain#")) FILTER NOT EXISTS {?p a owl:ObjectProperty} FILTER NOT EXISTS {?p a owl:DatatypeProperty} }

rules.message: Extension value datatype must match its declared definition.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:valueDatatype ?a; cd:fieldDefinition/cd:fieldDatatype ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Direct communication requires a protocol endpoint.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:communicationMode cd:communicationMode_Direct. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:protocolEndpoint ?e} }

rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:communicationMode cd:communicationMode_Gateway. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:gatewayStation ?e} }

rules.message: Commercial stations require a physical site.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:stationUse ?s. FILTER(?s IN (cd:stationUse_Public,cd:stationUse_Private)) FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:site ?e} }

rules.message: Personal stations require an owner account.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:stationUse cd:stationUse_Personal. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:ownerAccount ?o} }

rules.message: Charging area and station site must agree.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:site ?a; cd:area/cd:site ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Parking area and bay site must agree.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:site ?a; cd:area/cd:site ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: A payment terminal must serve exactly one station or area.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { {FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:station ?s} FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:area ?a}} UNION {$this cd:station ?s; cd:area ?a} }

rules.message: Physical circuit hierarchy must be acyclic.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:parentCircuit+ $this. }

rules.message: Virtual control hierarchy must be acyclic.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:parentControlGroup+ $this. }

rules.message: Nested physical circuits must remain on the same site.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:site ?a; cd:parentCircuit/cd:site ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Nested control groups must remain on the same site.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:site ?a; cd:parentControlGroup/cd:site ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Minimum current cannot exceed maximum current.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:minimumCurrentA ?a; cd:maximumCurrentA ?b. FILTER(?a > ?b) }

rules.message: Unknown payment availability cannot assert payment-option values.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:paymentOptionsKnowledge cd:paymentOptionsKnowledge_Unknown; cd:paymentOptionCode ?o. }

rules.message: Non-free authorization requires a credential or customer reference.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:authorizationMethod ?m. FILTER(?m != cd:authorizationMethod_LocalFree) FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:credential ?c} FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:customer ?u} }

rules.message: Authorization decision cannot predate its request.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:decidedAt ?d; cd:authorizationRequest/cd:requestedAt ?r. FILTER(?d < ?r) }

rules.message: Completed sessions require end time and end evidence.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:sessionState cd:sessionState_Completed. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:endedAt ?e} || !EXISTS {$this cd:endEvidence ?f}) }

rules.message: Session end cannot precede session start.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:startedAt ?a; cd:endedAt ?b. FILTER(?b < ?a) }

rules.message: Finalization evidence must describe the same session.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:endEvidence/cd:session ?s. FILTER(?s != $this) }

rules.message: Active charging requires accepted authorization.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:sessionState ?s; cd:authorizationDecision/cd:decision ?d. FILTER(?s IN (cd:sessionState_Active,cd:sessionState_Suspended,cd:sessionState_Completed) && ?d != cd:decision_Accepted) }

rules.message: Selected tariff must be effective at session start.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:startedAt ?s; cd:selectedTariff ?t. ?t cd:validFrom ?a. OPTIONAL {?t cd:validUntil ?b} FILTER(?s < ?a || (BOUND(?b) && ?s >= ?b)) }

rules.message: Authorization target must match the charged unit.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:chargingUnit ?a; cd:authorizationDecision/cd:authorizationRequest/cd:chargingUnit ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: A source timestamp ahead of receipt time requires a documented clock assessment.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:occurredAt ?a; cd:receivedAt ?b. FILTER(?b < ?a) FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:clockAssessment ?c} }

rules.message: A verified signature must have a verification timestamp.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:signatureVerification cd:signatureVerification_Valid. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:verifiedAt ?d} }

rules.message: Local CDRs require a completed canonical session.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:recordOrigin cd:recordOrigin_Local. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:session/cd:sessionState cd:sessionState_Completed} }

rules.message: Original local CDR import and export energy must agree with the canonical session.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:recordOrigin cd:recordOrigin_Local; cd:session ?s; cd:importedEnergyKWh ?a; cd:exportedEnergyKWh ?b. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:correctionOf ?old} ?s cd:importedEnergyKWh ?c; cd:exportedEnergyKWh ?d. FILTER(?a != ?c || ?b != ?d) }

rules.message: CDR correction lineage must be acyclic.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:correctionOf+ $this. }

rules.message: Priced tariffs require at least one price component.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:tariffMode cd:tariffMode_Priced. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:priceComponent ?p} }

rules.message: Discount tariffs require an explicit base or a declared deferred base-selection policy.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:tariffMode cd:tariffMode_DiscountBased. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:baseTariffVersion ?b} FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:baseTariffSelection ?mode. FILTER(?mode IN (cd:baseTariffSelection_SetBase,cd:baseTariffSelection_RoamingWholesale))} }

rules.message: Dynamic tariffs require a formula.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:tariffMode cd:tariffMode_Dynamic. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:dynamicPriceFormula ?f} }

rules.message: Tariff derivation must be acyclic.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:baseTariffVersion+ $this. }

rules.message: Tariff assignment priorities within a set must be unique.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:tariffAssignment ?a,?b. ?a cd:priority ?p. ?b cd:priority ?p. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Price intervals require exactly one explicit or recurring window.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { {FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:interval ?a} FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:recurringWindow ?b}} UNION {$this cd:interval ?a; cd:recurringWindow ?b} }

rules.message: Generation fractions must sum to one within decimal tolerance.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { {SELECT $this (SUM(?x) AS ?sum) WHERE {$this cd:sourceShare/cd:shareFraction ?x} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(ABS(?sum - 1) > 0.000001) }

rules.message: Dynamic price lower bound cannot exceed upper bound.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:minimumUnitPrice ?a; cd:maximumUnitPrice ?b. FILTER(?a > ?b) }

rules.message: Stored gross amount must equal rounded net plus rounded tax.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:netAmount ?n; cd:taxAmount ?t; cd:grossAmount ?g. FILTER(?g != ?n + ?t) }

rules.message: Invoice totals must agree with the sum of its lines.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:netAmount ?net; cd:taxAmount ?tax; cd:grossAmount ?gross. {SELECT $this (SUM(?n) AS ?ns) (SUM(?t) AS ?ts) (SUM(?g) AS ?gs) WHERE {$this cd:invoiceLine ?l. ?l cd:netAmount ?n; cd:taxAmount ?t; cd:grossAmount ?g} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(?net != ?ns || ?tax != ?ts || ?gross != ?gs) }

rules.message: Invoice line currencies must match the document.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:currency ?a; cd:invoiceLine/cd:currency ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Authorization currency must match its payment intent.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:currency ?a; cd:paymentIntent/cd:currency ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Capture currency must match its payment intent.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:currency ?a; cd:paymentIntent/cd:currency ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Refund currency must match the original capture.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:currency ?a; cd:paymentCapture/cd:currency ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Confirmed refunds may not exceed the confirmed capture amount.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:capturedAmount ?cap. {SELECT $this (SUM(?amount) AS ?total) WHERE {?r cd:paymentCapture $this; a cd:Refund; cd:refundState cd:refundState_Confirmed; cd:refundAmount ?amount} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(?total > ?cap) }

rules.message: Confirmed captures may not exceed requested payment amount.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:requestedAmount ?limit. {SELECT $this (SUM(?amount) AS ?total) WHERE {?c cd:paymentIntent $this; a cd:PaymentCapture; cd:captureState cd:captureState_Confirmed; cd:capturedAmount ?amount} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(?total > ?limit) }

rules.message: Posted journal must balance independently per currency.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:journalState cd:journalState_Posted. {SELECT $this ?currency (SUM(?amount) AS ?total) WHERE {$this cd:journalLine ?l. ?l cd:signedAmount ?amount; cd:currency ?currency} GROUP BY $this ?currency} FILTER(?total != 0) }

rules.message: Journal line currency must match its ledger account.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:currency ?a; cd:ledgerAccount/cd:currency ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Sponsor plus driver allocation must equal the total charge.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:totalAmount ?a; cd:sponsorAmount ?s; cd:driverAmount ?d. FILTER(?a != ?s + ?d) }

rules.message: Policy-sourced reimbursement requires an explicit electricity schedule.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:reimbursementRateSource cd:reimbursementRateSource_Policy. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:electricitySchedule ?s} }

rules.message: Station-sourced reimbursement must not embed a competing policy schedule.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:reimbursementRateSource cd:reimbursementRateSource_Station; cd:electricitySchedule ?s. }

rules.message: A contract-scoped reimbursement policy must identify its partner.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:serviceAgreement ?a. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:partner ?p} }

rules.message: Reimbursement evidence must be for a personal station.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:session/cd:chargingUnit/cd:station/cd:stationUse ?k. FILTER(?k != cd:stationUse_Personal) }

rules.message: Station-derived reimbursement requires the station electricity schedule.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:reimbursementPolicy/cd:reimbursementRateSource cd:reimbursementRateSource_Station. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:session/cd:chargingUnit/cd:station/cd:electricitySchedule ?s} }

rules.message: Relative coupon validity requires a duration; fixed validity requires both dates.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { {$this cd:validityMode cd:validityMode_DaysAfterRedemption. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:validityDays ?d}} UNION {$this cd:validityMode cd:validityMode_FixedWindow. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:validFrom ?a} || !EXISTS {$this cd:validUntil ?b})} }

rules.message: Coupon consumption must not exceed its energy allowance; reversal records subtract.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:energyAllowanceKWh ?limit. {SELECT $this (SUM(?signed) AS ?total) WHERE {?c cd:energyCoupon $this; a cd:CouponConsumption; cd:consumedEnergyKWh ?e. BIND(IF(EXISTS {?c cd:reversalOf ?r},-?e,?e) AS ?signed)} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(?total > ?limit || ?total < 0) }

rules.message: Coupon use must occur within its validity interval.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:consumedAt ?t; cd:energyCoupon ?c. ?c cd:validFrom ?a; cd:validUntil ?b. FILTER(?t < ?a || ?t >= ?b) }

rules.message: Reversal must reference a consumption of the same coupon.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:energyCoupon ?a; cd:reversalOf/cd:energyCoupon ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Schedule periods must lie within schedule validity.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:validFrom ?a; cd:validUntil ?b; cd:schedulePeriod ?p. ?p cd:periodStart ?s; cd:periodEnd ?e. FILTER(?s < ?a || ?e > ?b) }

rules.message: Schedule periods in one schedule must not overlap.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:schedulePeriod ?a,?b. ?a cd:periodStart ?s1; cd:periodEnd ?e1. ?b cd:periodStart ?s2; cd:periodEnd ?e2. FILTER(?a != ?b && ?s1 < ?e2 && ?s2 < ?e1) }

rules.message: Forecast bounds must contain the predicted value.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:predictedValue ?v. OPTIONAL {$this cd:lowerBound ?a} OPTIONAL {$this cd:upperBound ?b} FILTER((BOUND(?a) && ?v < ?a) || (BOUND(?b) && ?v > ?b)) }

rules.message: Availability seconds must be positive and bounded.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:eligibleSeconds ?a; cd:unavailableSeconds ?b. FILTER(?a <= 0 || ?b > ?a) }

rules.message: Availability fraction must agree with eligible and unavailable seconds.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:eligibleSeconds ?a; cd:unavailableSeconds ?b; cd:availabilityFraction ?f. FILTER(?a > 0 && ABS(?f-(1-?b/?a)) > 0.000001) }

rules.message: Completed work orders require timestamp and completion evidence.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:workState cd:workState_Completed. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:completedAt ?t} || !EXISTS {$this cd:completionEvidence ?e}) }

rules.message: Completed installations require commissioning evidence.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:jobState cd:jobState_Completed. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:completedAt ?t} || !EXISTS {$this cd:commissioningEvidence ?e}) }

rules.message: Accepted fiscalization requires an authority reference and fiscal evidence.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:fiscalizationState cd:fiscalizationState_Accepted. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:authorityReference ?r} || !EXISTS {$this cd:fiscalDocument ?e}) }

rules.message: The default language must be one of the supported languages.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:defaultLanguage ?l. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:supportedLanguage ?l} }

rules.message: Approved assistant actions must reference the exact proposed command.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:approvalDecision cd:approvalDecision_Approved; cd:recommendation ?r. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:approvedCommand ?c. ?r cd:proposedCommand ?c} }

rules.message: Delivered events must not retain a retry timestamp.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:deliveryState cd:deliveryState_Delivered; cd:nextRetryAt ?r. }

rules.message: Successful command state requires successful completion evidence, not acknowledgement alone.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:commandState cd:commandState_Succeeded. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?o a cd:CommandOutcome; cd:command $this; cd:outcomeKind cd:outcomeKind_Completion; cd:outcomeState cd:outcomeState_Succeeded} }

rules.message: Lifecycle transition must be permitted for the stated property and prior/next codes.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:stateProperty ?p; cd:previousState ?a; cd:nextState ?b. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?rule cd:transitionProperty ?p; cd:fromState ?a; cd:toState ?b} }

rules.message: Optional effective timestamps must define a positive half-open interval.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:validFrom ?a; cd:validUntil ?b. FILTER(?b <= ?a) }

rules.message: Half-open interval must have positive duration.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:startsAt ?a; cd:endsAt ?b. FILTER(?b <= ?a) }

rules.message: Schedule interval must have positive duration.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:periodStart ?a; cd:periodEnd ?b. FILTER(?b <= ?a) }

rules.message: Command expiry must be after request time.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:requestedAt ?a; cd:expiresAt ?b. FILTER(?b <= ?a) }

rules.message: Inclusive reimbursement end date cannot precede the start date.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:validFromDate ?a; cd:validUntilDate ?b. FILTER(?b < ?a) }

rules.message: Due date cannot precede invoice issuance.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:issuedAt ?a; cd:dueAt ?b. FILTER(?b < ?a) }

rules.message: Reservation expiry must be after reservation time.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:reservedAt ?a; cd:expiresAt ?b. FILTER(?b <= ?a) }

rules.message: Local time ordering must agree with the overnight flag.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:localStart ?a; cd:localEnd ?b; cd:spansMidnight ?s. FILTER((! ?s && ?b <= ?a) || (?s && ?b > ?a)) }

rules.message: Authorization expiry must be after authorization time.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:authorizedAt ?a; cd:expiresAt ?b. FILTER(?b <= ?a) }

rules.message: When a CDR has a tariff snapshot their currencies must agree.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:currency ?a; cd:selectedTariff/cd:currency ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Settlement items must have the batch currency and agreement.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:currency ?a; cd:serviceAgreement ?b; cd:settlementItem ?i. ?i cd:currency ?c; cd:serviceAgreement ?d. FILTER(?a != ?c || ?b != ?d) }

rules.message: Snapshot policy version must identify the referenced immutable policy version.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:policyVersion ?a; cd:corporateBillingPolicy/cd:policyVersion ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Voucher and wallet currencies must agree.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:voucher/cd:currency ?a; cd:wallet/cd:currency ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b) }

rules.message: Firmware must list the station model as compatible.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:firmware ?f; cd:station/cd:equipmentModel ?m. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?f cd:compatibleModel ?m} }

rules.message: Station using personal reimbursement must be classified personal.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:reimbursementPolicy ?p; cd:stationUse ?s. FILTER(?s != cd:stationUse_Personal) }

rules.message: Corporate pricing limits cannot be negative.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this ?p ?v. FILTER(?p IN (cd:costCapPerKWh,cd:maximumEnergyUnitPrice,cd:maximumIdleUnitPrice,cd:maximumFlatFee)) FILTER(?v < 0) }

rules.message: Percentage discounts are bounded between zero and one hundred.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:discountBasis cd:discountBasis_Percentage; cd:discountMagnitude ?v. FILTER(?v < 0 || ?v > 100) }

rules.message: Component fee floor cannot exceed its ceiling.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:minimumCharge ?a; cd:maximumCharge ?b. FILTER(?a > ?b) }

rules.message: Tier upper bound must exceed its inclusive lower bound.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:tierLowerBound ?a; cd:tierUpperBound ?b. FILTER(?b <= ?a) }

rules.message: Session charge floor cannot exceed its ceiling.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:minimumSessionCharge ?a; cd:maximumSessionCharge ?b. FILTER(?a > ?b) }

rules.message: Confirmed payouts require confirmation time.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:payoutState cd:payoutState_Confirmed. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:confirmedAt ?t} }

rules.message: Payout batch currency and total must agree with included payouts.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { {$this cd:currency ?a; cd:payout/cd:currency ?b. FILTER(?a != ?b)} UNION {$this cd:batchTotal ?t. {SELECT $this (SUM(?v) AS ?s) WHERE {$this cd:payout/cd:payoutAmount ?v} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(?t != ?s)} }

rules.message: DC cabinet capacity must be positive and at least one module.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:totalCabinetPowerKW ?t; cd:moduleSizeKW ?m. FILTER(?m <= 0 || ?t < ?m) }

rules.message: Allocated power must agree with module count and not exceed cabinet capacity.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:allocatedModules ?n; cd:allocatedPowerKW ?p; cd:powerCabinet ?c. ?c cd:moduleSizeKW ?m; cd:totalCabinetPowerKW ?total. FILTER(?p != ?n * ?m || ?p > ?total) }

rules.message: Recurring profiles require recurrence kind; transaction-specific profiles require a transaction.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { {$this cd:profileKind cd:profileKind_Recurring. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:recurrenceKind ?r}} UNION {$this cd:profilePurpose cd:profilePurpose_TransactionSpecific. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:protocolTransaction ?t}} }

rules.message: Access-token expiration must follow issuance.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:issuedAt ?a; cd:expiresAt ?b. FILTER(?b <= ?a) }

rules.message: Revoked access tokens require a revocation timestamp.
rules.query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
